title: Intent Capture with Google Search Architecture
overview: Structure single-theme ad groups (STAGs) with exact and phrase match intent layers.
Eliminate ad spend waste using exhaustive negative keyword lists and search term mining.

takeaways.title: Search Term Mining
takeaways.desc: Routinely convert high-converting search queries into isolated exact match keywords.

takeaways.title: Quality Score Gains
takeaways.desc: Align landing page H1s with ad copy to lower cost per click by up to 35%.
